items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: Stan Getz offered me a gig that night at Carnegie Hall, right after the gig... he said when you get off this band call me.

ctx.x: Wow. Well how was Woody Herman different?

All right. I came back, after Maynard’s band, went back with Gap Mangione for another year. Then Woody Herman’s band called and I went with that band. And that band was an exciting band. It was one of the bands I wanted to play with. I had played “La Fiesta” with Maynard Ferguson for two years, and now I’m back playing “La Fiesta” with Woody Herman for another two years, which is basically a slightly different version because it doesn’t have all of the high, featuring Maynard and that. But like “Four Brothers,”…
Jake, he was a pistol, huh?
